cards.label: Hampstead Heath
cards.text: An older woman with four dogs and the bearing of a small aristocracy nods at you like you're expected. One of the dogs sniffs your bag with professional interest.

cards.speaker: Dogwalker
cards.text: "You're doing the ore thing, aren't you. Everyone up here can tell. Here — Wellington dug this up under an oak. Waste on me, not on him."
She's gone before you can ask which dog is Wellington. All four look equally capable of digging up the past.
